cats.name: 機場
cats.v1: 擴建型：沿 a 長條兩層玻璃航廈＋雙空橋雙噴射機＋陸側停車場，高塔台移到北角、塔頂加雷達座，正好托住繪製端疊畫的旋轉雷達。
cats.v2: 通用航空機場：前緣跑道＋大小兩座筒拱機庫＋拱窗航站樓（樓頂塔艙）＋螺旋槳機、油罐車、風向袋，北角加一座紅白桁架雷達塔托住雷達。
cats.notes: 素材走通用那一行，但繪製端會在畫布 (136,70) 疊一個會轉的雷達（index.html 約 24873 行），v0 上這顆雷達是浮在空中的。本輪修正：v1 塔台與 v2 桁架塔的頂面都算準落在 (136,70)，已在樣張上疊假雷達核對過位置，兩個變體的雷達都有支撐。代價是塔身約 105px，在場站裡最顯眼；另外若日後雷達掛點改了，塔頂會變成空的。跑道起點往後退了 4 格，讓出塔基位置。畫布 272x300 與 v0 相同。

cats.name: 國際機場
cats.v1: 弧頂主航廈＋中央指廊三個機位＋高塔台＋立體停車樓（頂層停車）＋山牆貨運機庫。
cats.v2: 雙平行跑道＋圓形穹頂衛星廳（三個機位）＋高架捷運廊＋摺板屋頂陸側航廈＋蘑菇頭塔台。
cats.notes: 沿用上一位設計師的版本，放大 2 倍逐區看過，沒發現浮空、裁切或雜點，本輪沒有改。v2 的摺板屋頂陸側航廈有點像鋸齒廠房，靠玻璃帶才認得出是航廈。執行期的 v0 本身看起來是壞的（航廈、塔台、灰盒浮在地坪菱形上方），不在本批範圍，已記在 problems。

cats.name: 貨運站
cats.v1: 磚造山牆貨棧＋月台雨棚（柱落地）＋藍色箱車＋月台貨物與棧板，低而長。
cats.v2: 貨櫃轉運場：跨雙軌的黃色龍門吊（高瘦骨架）＋雙層貨櫃堆＋平車載櫃＋調度亭。
cats.notes: 放大 4 倍檢查，沒發現問題，沒改。夜光只在雨棚燈、貨棧拱窗、龍門吊警示燈、調度亭窗上。

cats.name: 倉儲物流中心
cats.v1: 寬體低矮配送中心：鋸齒天窗屋頂＋右牆五道捲門＋兩台半聯結車靠門＋叉車與棧板。
cats.v2: 高架自動倉：高瘦的立體倉（藍色頂帶、壁柱）＋低層裝卸棟＋樓梯塔＋貨車場。
cats.notes: 放大 4 倍檢查，高低胖瘦對比清楚，密度與 v0 相當，沒改。

cats.name: 遊艇碼頭
cats.v1: 遊艇俱樂部：兩層白色會所配四坡藍瓦＋木棧道＋雙指狀浮橋停四艘艇＋旗桿與草坪。
cats.v2: 修艇場：橘色山牆大船屋（開口朝水）＋兩層乾式艇架＋水池內兩艘艇。
cats.notes: 放大 4 倍檢查，沒改。小缺點：v2 下水滑道船架上那艘帆船大半被船屋擋住，幾乎看不到。

cats.name: 貿易站
cats.v1: 筒拱關棧：綠色拱頂貨棧＋拱窗拱門＋桅桿吊臂吊著貨箱＋鐵軌月台＋貨箱堆。
cats.v2: 露天集散棚：長條四坡紅瓦開放市棚（柱落地，棚下有貨）＋高聳信號旗桿＋帳房小屋。
cats.notes: 放大 4 倍檢查，沒改。兩個變體的輪廓（拱頂實牆 vs 開放棚＋高桿）差異明顯。

cats.name: 釣魚碼頭
cats.v1: L 形木棧橋＋岸邊餌料小屋＋路燈＋繫泊小舟。
cats.v2: 石砌防波堤釣台＋堤頭紅白航標燈柱（夜亮綠燈）＋消波塊＋欄杆樁。
cats.notes: 沒改。繪製端 22680 行會在格子南角疊一個釣客（60% 機率），三個版本都會出現，位置可接受。v1 深色外框偏多，縮小看有點糊，但身分讀得出來。

cats.name: 碼頭亭
cats.v1: 渡輪售票亭：白木低矮亭＋紅四坡頂＋條紋雨遮售票窗＋時刻牌＋長椅與繫纜樁（胖而低）。
cats.v2: 雙重簷霧鐘亭：石台座＋四根柱＋簷下銅鐘＋上下兩層紅瓦與中間的小閣（高、層疊輪廓）。
cats.notes: 本輪修正 v2：原本銅鐘在對角線上，被前角柱和下層屋簷完全擋住，名為鐘亭卻看不到鐘。改法是柱子改立在四邊中點、柱高 14 加到 21、整個屋頂上移 7px，現在銅鐘在兩柱之間、簷下露出來了。夜光只留紅燈籠和小閣窗，銅鐘不發光。

cats.name: 燈塔
cats.v1: 矮胖石砌燈塔＋紅頂守塔人小屋（煙囪）＋礁石。
cats.v2: 紅色鋼骨桁架燈塔（高瘦，畫布上方加 16px、ay=126）＋設備小屋。
cats.notes: 本輪修正 v1：礁石原本是淺色橢圓，和地面同色，只剩外框，看起來像圓環或人孔蓋；改成深色不規則多邊形加左上受光面。另外記錄：繪製端 22004 行的夜間光束起點固定在南頂點上方 40px，三個版本（含 v0）都對不上燈室高度，這是既有行為。

cats.name: 海豚灣劇場（batches.json 誤標為熱氣球基地）
cats.v1: 露天海灣劇場：三階看台＋四根桅桿撐起的雙曲張拉膜＋前方大表演池，池中有斜躍而出的海豚（深背淺腹、背鰭、尾鰭點水），另加浮球。
cats.v2: 筒拱水族廳：白色拱頂長廳＋浪紋腰帶與舷窗＋山牆大拱窗（加窗櫺）＋前右的海豚噴泉圓池（池緣兩顆水下燈）。
cats.notes: k181 實際是海豚灣劇場（index.html 1327 行 KNAME），不是熱氣球基地（那是 k180）。本輪兩個變體都重做了大部分。v1 原本的表演池被看台和售票亭擋住，海豚是一團灰塊，售票亭像紙箱；現在拿掉售票亭、把池子放大、重畫海豚，帆篷改成四角雙曲膜。v2 原本前右的雕像座加長椅是一團雜點，拱窗裡的「海豚剪影」看起來像皺眉臉；現在換成海豚噴泉圓池加窗櫺，夜光只落在池緣兩顆燈座上。仍不完美：v1 海豚約 15px，要放大才確定是海豚；張拉膜北角偏高，還是有點像帳篷尖頂。

problems: batches.json 的 b01 把 k181 標成「熱氣球基地」，但 index.html 1327 行的 KNAME 是 180=熱氣球基地、181=海豚灣劇場。批次檔依實際的 k181（海豚灣劇場）設計。
k19 繪製端雷達疊畫（index.html 約 24873 行）固定在畫布 (136,70)。執行期 v0 在那個位置沒有任何結構，雷達是浮空的（既有問題，不在本批範圍）。本批 v1/v2 刻意在該點下方加了塔或桁架塔托住它；若日後改掛點，變體塔頂會變成空的。
k114 執行期的 v0（114_1_0）看起來是壞的：航廈、塔台、灰色方盒浮在地坪菱形上方很高處，疑似後製鏈或原圖錯位，不在本批範圍，建議另開卡查。
k69 夜間光束疊畫（index.html 約 22004 行）起點固定在南頂點上方 40px，和 v0/v1/v2 的燈室高度都不一致（既有行為）。
未改動、只做放大檢查就沿用的類別：114、110、64、90、91、97。這幾類沒有做兩輪「改→渲染」，因為檢查後判定不需要修改。

cats.name: 太陽能
cats.v1: Solar tower power station: a tall white receiver tower with a glowing collector ring, surrounded by a checkerboard of heliostat mirrors that tilt toward the tower, plus a control hut. This round I enlarged the mirrors from about 9px to 12px wide and added a dark bottom edge.
cats.v2: Agrivoltaic farm (panels over crops): three long rows of blue panels raised on posts over green crop strips, with shadows cast on the ground, plus two battery containers (with LEDs) and a transformer. This replaces the previous designer's dish array, which read like satellite antennas.
cats.notes: v1 kept the previous designer's tower and only enlarged the mirrors. v2 was rewritten because the dishes lost the solar identity. v0 has small posts sticking out below the plate; the variants don't copy that. Night lights sit only on the control hut window and the container LEDs.

cats.name: 油井
cats.v1: Modern pumpjack: a yellow walking beam and horse head, a three-legged A-frame, a crank with counterweight, a concrete base and oil drums.
cats.v2: Old wooden derrick: a tall tapered timber lattice with a gable-roofed engine house and wooden barrels.
cats.notes: Kept the previous designer's work unchanged. I checked it zoomed in at iter1 and in the final sheet: no floating parts, no cropping, and the silhouettes differ clearly (low pumpjack vs. tall derrick). Night lights come only from the red warning light and the engine house windows.

cats.name: 礦場
cats.v1: Steel shaft headframe: a red steel frame with back bracing, two sheave wheels at the top, a hoist house, a shaft house and an ore cart on rails.
cats.v2: Open-pit mine: a three-level stepped pit, an ore cone, a conveyor running up to a wooden ore bin, and an ore cart in the pit.
cats.notes: Kept unchanged. v2 is the low, flat one and the weakest of the three: its footprint is small and it reads less strongly than v1. It is still recognisable as a mine (pit, conveyor, ore bin), so I didn't rework it.

cats.name: 核電廠
cats.v1: Twin-unit expansion: one huge cooling tower (about 100px tall, red aviation bands, steam leaving the rim), two dome-topped containment buildings with a radiation sign, a braced vent stack, a long turbine hall with a skylight, and a switchyard with three transformers and a lattice pylon.
cats.v2: Newer single-unit plant with no cooling towers: a large cylindrical shield building with a roof water tank, a wrap-around auxiliary building, a turbine building with tall windows, a row of low fan-cooled towers with small steam puffs, and a sunken cooling pond.
cats.notes: This category was missing from the file; I built it new. Palettes follow v0's generation code (tower white/grey bands, red aviation band, containment cream, turbine hall blue-grey). Iteration fixes: removed a dotted power line running off the plate, and lowered the steam so it meets the tower rim. v2 relies on the dome and the plant layout rather than the classic cooling-tower shape; the containment dome and the red roof light still say nuclear. Night lights sit only on drawn windows, skylights and aviation lights. I dropped v0's green glow over the dome.

cats.name: 水力發電廠
cats.v1: Isometric gravity dam: the reservoir sits high behind the dam, with two intake towers and walkways, white spillway water, a powerhouse below the dam, and a right-bank rock cliff.
cats.v2: River barrage: several gate piers with steel gates and falling water, a red gantry crane with a yellow cab, a large brick powerhouse, and river water flowing out.
cats.notes: Kept unchanged. v0 is drawn flat, facing the viewer; v1 and v2 are proper isometric, so their style differs from v0 but matches the rest of the game's isometric buildings. I checked for floating parts and cropping and found none.

cats.name: 地熱發電
cats.v1: Fan-cooled cooling tower building (a grey louvred block with two fan stacks letting off steam), a green turbine house matching v0's green, and a wellhead pipe with a valve.
cats.v2: Two open-topped silencer towers letting off steam, a tall steam separator, connecting pipes, and a small green control building.
cats.notes: Kept unchanged. v0's canvas is 64x112 anchored at 32,110; v1/v2 are 72x112 anchored at 36,110 with the same footprint, which is why the sheet reports diff as 'size'. Both variants are shorter and wider than v0's tall pipe tower.

cats.name: 垃圾焚化發電廠
cats.v1: Expanded, taller plant: a terracotta-clad boiler house with ribbon windows and a roof monitor, a baghouse dust filter, a concrete twin-flue chimney with red and white bands, a separate tipping hall with three dump doors, a blue-grey turbine house, a transformer kiosk with a blue generator window, and a garbage truck.
cats.v2: Old-style municipal plant: a red-brick gable-roofed boiler house with four arched windows, a tapered square brick chimney with a white band and beacon, an open refuse pit with a yellow gantry grab crane, a gable-roofed generator house with a blue generator window, and a garbage truck.
cats.notes: The sprite itself is chosen by the generic vdraw574 line, but the game draws an extra overlay for k62 (T363, around index.html line 24633) at fixed canvas positions: chimney tip (111,23) with exhaust and a blinking red light, plus a cool blue night glow at (95..112,133..141). Both variants keep the 136x150 canvas and anchor 68,148. The chimney tops and red lights sit exactly at (110..112,23..24), and the front right of each variant has a blue generator window near x 95..112 for the glow. That window sits a few pixels above the glow box; v0 has a similar mismatch. This category was missing from the file; I built it new. v2 also uses the owner's requested arched windows.

cats.name: 天然氣井
cats.v1: Compressor station: a tall flare stack with guy lines and a live flame, a corrugated compressor building, two horizontal white tanks, and a red valve on the pipework.
cats.v2: Gas holder site: a gas holder inside a red lattice guide frame (shrunk this round), a larger wellhead valve tree with two red valve wheels, a vertical separator vessel, and a ground-level gathering pipe.
cats.notes: In the previous designer's v2 the gas holder took over the tile and the wellhead was only a few pixels, so the site didn't read as a well. I shrank the holder (radius 17 to 14, frame height 40 to 34), pushed it back, and put an enlarged wellhead and separator in front. v1 is unchanged; its horizontal tanks read a bit blobby but are acceptable.

cats.name: 化肥廠
cats.v1: Prilling tower plant: a very tall white prilling tower with red bands and a top house, a gable-roofed bulk store, a slanted conveyor gallery, a production hall and fertilizer sacks.
cats.v2: Two white liquid-ammonia spheres on legs with a pipe rack, a long corrugated arched bulk store, and a yellow loader.
cats.notes: Kept unchanged. v1's canvas is enlarged to 136x166, anchored at 68,164, so the tall tower fits without being cropped. The previous designer's sprite also sets a smoke anchor on it, but smoke is only rendered for k3/k5/k1, so for k118 it has no effect.

cats.name: 食品加工廠
cats.v1: Large food plant expansion: a tall white spray-drying tower with a blue band, four stainless silos, a white processing hall with a blue band, a yellow can-logo sign and three loading doors, a cold store with rooftop units, and two refrigerated trucks.
cats.v2: Old cannery: a three-storey red-brick factory with arched windows, a cornice and a wooden water tank on the roof, a round brick chimney, a gable-roofed boiler house, and a rail siding with a boxcar, a loading platform and crates.
cats.notes: This category was missing from the file; I built it new. Both keep v0's plate colours (#9a9488) and its yellow sign with red can marks. v2 has more windows than v0 but no more detail per area, and only about 55% of the arched windows light up at night (chosen with a fixed seed). v1's trucks wait parallel to the loading doors instead of backed into them.

cats.name: 釀酒廠
cats.v1: Old distillery: a red-brick gable-roofed still house with arched windows, a white malting kiln with a pagoda roof, a copper vent and a stack of oak barrels.
cats.v2: Modern craft brewery: a glass brewhouse showing copper kettles, a row of four stainless fermentation tanks, and a malt silo with its feed pipe.
cats.notes: Kept unchanged. Checked at iter1 and in the final sheet with no problems. v2's glass brewhouse glows at night; that light falls on glazing drawn in the daytime image, so it follows the lights rule.

cats.name: 中央廚房
cats.v1: Logistics-style central kitchen: a two-storey long building with red band, windows, loading doors and rooftop units, plus a newly added taller rear cooking block (red band, windows on its visible side, rooftop exhaust hood and stainless duct), with refrigerated vans in front.
cats.v2: Food factory with a sawtooth glass roof and red band, a cold store, a stainless exhaust stack with wall brackets, and a van.
cats.notes: In the previous v1 the building filled only the front left of the plate and the back half was empty. I added the taller rear cooking block. I also tried parked vans in the back-left lot, but the main building hid them, so I removed them. v2 is unchanged; its sawtooth skylights glow quite brightly at night, but that light sits on glazing drawn in the daytime image, so it follows the lights rule. If it feels too bright, lower that night overlay's alpha from 0.55.

problems: When I took over, variants574/b02.js passed the syntax check but had no k58, k62 or k57 at all. I added all six of those variants and kept the previous designer's nine categories rather than rewriting the file.

Fixed from the previous work: k25 v2's dish array read like antennas, so I replaced it with an agrivoltaic farm; k25 v1's mirrors were too small, so I enlarged them; k119 v1 left the back half of the plate empty, so I added a rear building; k117 v2's wellhead was too small to read, so I rebalanced it.

k62 has an extra overlay drawn at fixed canvas positions (T363): the chimney tip (111,23) and a night glow box (95..112,133..141). The variants keep the same canvas, anchor and chimney-tip point. The blue generator window sits a few pixels above the glow box, which also happens with v0.
k60 v1/v2 canvases (72 wide) differ from v0 (64 wide) and k118 v1 is 136x166, so the sheet reports diffVsV0 as 'size'. The footprint positions are unchanged.

Every variant is a full redraw on the same footprint using v0's colours, not a compose on top of v0, because the v0 sprites cover the whole plate and leave nothing to build on. Everything is drawn with integer pixels and seeded randomness only (RND = A.metroRand516); no shared random stream is used.

All renders ran on port 8212 through variant-sheet.js with scale 2 and at most 3 categories per iteration. Close-ups were cropped with Python/PIL into the scratchpad folder. I didn't modify index.html or anyone else's files and made no git commit.

cats.name: 監獄
cats.v1: 放射式老監獄：四角崗樓（外挑崗亭＋四坡頂＋探照燈）圍住高牆與刺網，牆內是十字形牢房翼加中央圓廳（錐頂），前牆中間有門樓。
cats.v2: 現代高度戒備監獄：一棟高板牢房樓（窄縫窗）、玻璃帶行政樓加雨遮、雙層鐵網、有鐵網圍著的運動場、鋼構崗哨，右前方有黃黑柵欄閘門。
cats.notes: 監獄身分靠高牆、崗樓、鐵網撐住，兩張圖一張磚石一張現代，輪廓差很多。沒做好的地方：v1 牆內的翼舍大半被前牆擋住，屋頂和院子地面對比偏低，內部看起來有點糊。v2 的鐵網沒加外框，改用深色細線，否則太重；拉遠看會偏淡。夜圖只點亮崗亭燈頭、少數縫窗和行政樓玻璃分格，沒有照 v0 畫光錐。

cats.name: 市政廳
cats.v1: 圓頂議事堂：中間主體上有高鼓座（一圈窗）、綠銅穹頂和燈亭，左右各一棟低翼樓（四坡頂＋拱窗），正面是五柱山牆門廊，兩側各一根旗桿。
cats.v2: 紅磚鐘樓市府：左後方一座高鐘樓（兩面鐘、鐘室拱窗、綠銅金字塔頂），右後是雙坡主廳（有煙囪），左前是階梯山牆翼樓（玫瑰窗＋大門），右前是噴水廣場。
cats.notes: 有自訂繪製路徑：index.html 約 24865 行 `if(bd.k===7||bd.k===9||bd.k===42)` 會在素材畫布座標 (68,16) 疊一面動畫旗，位置寫死，不看變體。兩個變體都已對好這個掛點：v1 把燈亭頂放在 (32,32,61)，畫布上緣裁掉 39px（素材變成 136x111、ay=109，畫面位置不變）；v2 塔尖落在 (22,22,90)，剛好是畫布 (68,16)，畫布維持 136x150。v1 是本批唯一比 v0 矮的畫布，整合時請確認沒有程式假設 2x2 素材高度一定是 150。另外從接觸表粗估，v0 自己的尖塔頂大約在畫布 y≈45，動畫旗在 v0 上可能本來就浮在塔尖上方約 29px。這點沒有實際驗證。

cats.name: 法院
cats.v1: 古典神殿式法院：三段台階台基、六柱門廊、三角楣上有金色天平，側牆拱窗，台階兩側各一盞燈柱。
cats.v2: 現代司法大樓：高板樓（左面直條玻璃、右面窗格、頂上有天平標誌），前方玻璃大廳裙樓加雨遮，另有旗桿和路燈。
cats.notes: 這兩張是上一位設計師留下的（未經審核）。我渲染看過，身分、結構、裁切都沒問題，所以保留，只把夜間大廳的整片光塊改成依玻璃分格的條狀光（alpha .5），並包進 try/catch。還沒處理的地方：兩個變體的石材都比 v0 的藍灰偏白偏亮，只能算次要的材質差；v2 高板樓約 60px 高，比 v0 高很多，放進街區會很顯眼。

cats.name: 消防總局
cats.v1: 紅磚古典消防局：兩層磚樓，正面四道拱形紅色車庫門、二樓拱窗；後方有高曬水帶塔（百葉開口、金字塔頂、紅旗、夜間紅燈），側邊加一棟宿舍翼樓，停車坪停兩部消防車（一部有雲梯），另有旗桿和消防栓。
cats.v2: 現代消防總局：四層玻璃辦公樓（紅色立鰭＋天線），寬幅車庫大廳有五道捲門、紅色腰帶，屋頂畫直升機坪（黃圈＋H＋邊燈）；後方有混凝土訓練塔（紅色陽台），前方停一部沿 u 向的雲梯車和一部指揮車。
cats.notes: v0 的長條紅樓加旁邊高塔，這個識別兩個變體都用結構方式換過了。沒做好的地方：v1 曬水帶塔上的白色石帶讓它有點像燈塔。v2 辦公樓夜間是隨機亮窗，已經降到機率 .3、alpha .5，但還是看得出格子感。

cats.name: 消防瞭望塔
cats.v1: 石砌圓塔：高而細，有石砌層線和縫窗，上方挑出木托迴廊，瞭望亭一圈玻璃（夜間點亮），紅色圓錐頂加小紅旗，塔腳有一間木造工具棚。
cats.v2: 鋼構瞭望台：四腳往上收的鋼架加 X 斜撐，上面是玻璃值勤艙、外圍走道、紅色平屋頂、天線和紅色信標、警報喇叭；塔腳旁有火險等級指示牌（綠黃紅）。比 v0 矮、比 v0 胖。
cats.notes: v1 走高瘦，v2 走矮胖，跟 v0 的木格塔三者輪廓都不同。沒做好的地方：v2 的鋼架線為了不變成粗黑格子沒加外框，拉遠可能偏淡。v1 的工具棚很小，看起來像一團棕色。

cats.name: 市民中心
cats.v1: U 形廣場市民會堂：中央是九柱列柱大廳，上有淺鉛灰圓頂和燈亭；左右兩翼是赤陶四坡頂，左翼朝中庭那面是拱廊；中庭鋪地磚，有噴泉、五色旗列（延續 v0 的旗）、長椅和樹。
cats.v2: 現代市民會館：筒拱大屋頂、全玻璃前廳加雨遮，前方是往舞台遞降的階梯劇場（舞台兩側有燈柱）；左側一根紅藍標誌柱（頂上有鐘面），另有旗和樹。
cats.notes: v0 的半圓頂大廳、橢圓廣場、旗子，v1 用圓頂加旗列加噴泉延續，v2 改成筒拱加劇場。已調整的地方：v1 旗列往後移到 v=86，左前那棵樹改小、改位置，因為原本擠在一起；v2 標誌柱從 54 降到 40，屋頂肋線改成每 23 單位一條，減少機庫感。仍然不理想的地方：v2 的筒拱大廳還是有點像體育館或機庫，市民中心的身分主要靠鐘面標誌柱、旗子和劇場撐；夜間玻璃是隨機亮格。

cats.name: 火葬場
cats.v1: 禮堂式火葬場：雙坡告別禮堂的山牆朝前（拱門＋圓窗＋側拱窗），後方接一間平頂爐房，旁邊一支高磚煙囪（兩道淺色箍＋頂帽），配兩棵柏樹和一條步道。
cats.v2: 現代火葬場：水平長條清水混凝土建築、深出簷、玻璃帶，屋頂上兩支高低不一的細鋼煙囪；前方有紀念水池，右前是小納骨牆，另有一棵圓冠樹。
cats.notes: smoke 已依新煙囪頂重新設定：v1 一點，v2 兩點，都用 I() 算出畫布座標。沒做好的地方：v2 的納骨牆很小，可能被看成普通箱體；v2 整體帶點小工廠味，火葬場身分主要靠雙煙囪加水池。

cats.name: 大墓園
cats.v1: 圍牆哥德禮拜堂墓園：低石牆加方柱，正面有拱門石柱門（柱頂燈），中軸是柏樹大道；中後方是脊沿 v 的禮拜堂，前面接一座尖塔鐘樓（十字、尖拱門、圓窗），右後有一座白色小陵墓，四塊草地分區立著疏排墓碑。
cats.v2: 草坪紀念公園：中央圓形廣場立一座方尖碑（兩階基座），後右是一字形納骨牆（面板加銅牌，有屋簷板），草地上是花崗岩色的疏排墓碑，右前有開放涼亭（頂燈），另有幾棵落葉樹和長椅。沒有圍牆。
cats.notes: v0 的地面整片都是場景，所以選擇重畫整個佈局。v1 畫布 208x226（pt=6，留給塔尖），v2 208x224（pt=4）。v0 左角有樹，取樣會取到樹，所以地塊色直接寫死 '#8a9280'。已修的問題：v1 墓碑一開始太密（機率 .8→.55／.72→.52）；v2 原本是很大的 L 形納骨迴廊，壓過整張圖，平放紀念石也像雜點，改成一字形矮牆加疏排直立碑。還能再改的地方：v1 後牆外側那一排墓碑仍有點碎。

cats.name: 信仰中心
cats.v1: 圓頂多元禮拜堂：圓形鼓座大廳（一圈拱窗）加二層鼓座和青綠大穹頂，正前方是尖拱門樓，後右一座細高塔（小穹頂），前庭有水鏡池和兩棵柏樹。
cats.v2: 東方重簷殿宇：石台基加台階，紅柱格扇大殿，重簷四坡頂（翹角、脊飾、金頂），前方有紅柱黑頂牌坊，兩盞石燈籠、一只香爐、一棵松。
cats.notes: v0 是西式教堂加鐘樓，兩個變體換成其他宗教建築語彙，符合原設定的中性多元宗教。v1 畫布 136x154（pt=4）。夜間只點亮拱窗、格扇、石燈籠。還能再改的地方：v2 的翹角只有 1–2px，縮小後不太明顯。

cats.name: 婚禮教堂
cats.v1: 圓形婚禮亭：兩階圓台，白色圓廳開一圈高拱窗（夜間點亮），上面是粉色穹頂加小燈亭；前方有粉白花拱門和紅毯，右側立雙環金色招牌。
cats.v2: 石造鐘樓小教堂：雙坡中殿（左面三個拱窗、右側山牆玫瑰窗），左前一座白色鐘樓（金色鐘、粉色尖錐頂），前方有白色花棚架、花圃和雙環招牌。
cats.notes: v1 刻意做得又矮又胖（圓形），v2 是不對稱的側塔，都和 v0 對稱山牆加中央尖塔不同。沒做好的地方：v1 比 v0 明顯矮小，放在城市裡存在感偏弱；花拱門只有約 7px 寬，細節很小。

problems: 接手狀況：上一位設計師的 b03.js 只完成 k43（引擎＋兩個變體）。因為語法正確、成品可用，我保留原本的引擎和 k43，在同一檔案裡擴充 scene/lay/com/fin、castShadow、cone/ring/cylPt、cypress/roundTree、v0col 等工具，補齊其餘 9 類。每類各包一個 try/catch，最後 node --check 通過。
k42 有自訂繪製路徑：遊戲會在素材畫布座標 (68,16) 疊一面動畫旗（index.html 約 24865 行，對象是 bd.k 7/9/42），不看變體。兩個變體都已把掛點對齊到這個位置；v1 因此把畫布上緣裁掉 39px（136x111、ay=109）。整合時請確認沒有程式假設 2x2 素材的 h 一定是 150。
畫布尺寸和 v0 不同的有：k42v1 136x111、k54v1 208x226、k54v2 208x224、k66v1 136x154。都依 ax/ay 規則補償，佔地位置不變。
操作失誤一次：我在 Bash 裡下了一條含 python heredoc 的指令，結果卡住逾時，已用 TaskStop 停掉。那條指令沒有寫入任何檔案，之後的修改都改用 Edit／node 字串替換。沒有執行、修改或刪除 click.ps1 和 shot-screen.ps1，也沒有碰 安卓探索 目錄。
shots574/b03_final_a.png 產出後沒有再打開看，為了遵守不重複開大圖的額度規則。JSON 裡每個變體的 px 和尺寸，和前幾輪逐類看過的疊代圖（iter5/6/9/10）完全相同。final_b 有打開確認。
從接觸表粗估：k42 v0 的尖塔頂大約在畫布 y≈45，所以 v0 自己的動畫旗可能浮在塔尖上方約 29px。這點沒有實際驗證，只記錄給整合者參考，沒有改 v0。

cats.name: 大學
cats.v1: 雙翼擴建：主樓兩側各加一棟紅瓦山牆講堂（屋脊方向互相垂直、拱窗），校園變寬變矮胖。
cats.v2: 尖塔換成銅綠穹頂加鼓座和燈籠亭，東角另立一座高瘦的獨立鐘樓（鐘面移到鐘樓上），加兩棵樹。
cats.notes: 上一位設計師做的，我放大看過，沒有浮空、裁切或雜點，保留原樣沒改。夜光只落在畫出來的拱窗、鼓座窗和鐘面上。

cats.name: 大學城
cats.v1: 方庭學院：兩排三層紅磚拱窗學舍加轉角哥德式鐘塔（尖頂、角尖塔、雙鐘面）圍出十字步道方庭，中央有雕像，前面是低矮拱廊迴廊，入口有燈柱。
cats.v2: 中軸主塔：方正紅磚主樓頂上升起兩段退縮的高聳學術塔加尖頂，前面是林蔭大草坪、中軸步道和噴泉；西側是現代玻璃科學館，東側是銅綠穹頂圓形講堂，前方有校門柱。
cats.notes: 這批新做的。v0 是平面立面圖，所以依 84/68/116 的前例改用等距重畫，佔地、錨點和地塊色都跟 v0 一樣。色票沿用 v0 的紅磚、米色鐘樓、紅瓦和草坪。一輪修正：v2 主塔第一段頂面原本沒填色，露出底色，已補上。和 v0 並排時畫風（等距 vs 平面）不同，這點由整合者判斷。

cats.name: 高中
cats.v1: L 形三層紅瓦教學樓（兩翼屋脊互相垂直）圍住前方的紅色跑道和草皮內場，內角立一座高出屋頂的鐘塔（樓梯間），旗桿在前面。
cats.v2: 五層帶狀窗的現代校舍（高瘦、頂上有樓梯間和水塔）配一棟筒拱屋頂的體育館（矮胖，拱形山牆是大片扇形玻璃），前面是紅土籃球場和旗桿。
cats.notes: 這批新做的，v0 是平面立面圖所以重畫。保住了身分元素：教學樓、跑道或球場、旗桿、紅瓦色。一輪修正：v1 鐘塔原本和屋頂一樣高，已加高讓它明顯突出。另外新寫了共用的筒拱屋頂 helper（vault）。

cats.name: 幼兒園
cats.v1: 單層紅瓦山牆長屋，牆腳有彩虹色帶，山牆有圓窗；前院有獨立的沙坑，右側是溜滑梯。
cats.v2: 兩層園舍，平屋頂是綠色屋頂花園，女兒牆一圈彩色，窗戶有拱形也有方框，東側立一座黃色蠟筆圓塔（紅色錐頂）。
cats.notes: 上一位設計師做的，我修了兩處。v1 的沙坑原本貼在屋身旁邊，看起來像多出一塊平台；已把房子往後移，沙坑獨立放到前院，溜滑梯也重新擺位。v2 移除了地塊尖角上像標記點的紅球，屋頂由米色改成屋頂花園綠，避免整棟看成一塊米色方塊。兩個變體的地塊都拿掉了 rk 撒點（避免雜點）。v1 的沙坑對比偏低，也比 v0 小，屬於刻意的矮小版。

cats.name: 研究院
cats.v1: 加高：屋頂退縮加一層實驗塔，塔頂有碟形天線和帶紅色警示燈的天線桿。
cats.v2: 水平園區：主樓後方加一棟低矮帶窗的實驗翼，東角加一座地面電波望遠鏡和控制箱。
cats.notes: 上一位設計師做的，放大檢查沒問題，沒改。

cats.name: 太空研究中心
cats.v1: 深空追蹤站：西角加一座雷達罩和一座大型追蹤碟形天線（有基座、控制櫃）。
cats.v2: 重型運載：西角加第二座發射台，上面是捆綁助推器的高火箭加紅色格構勤務塔和泛光燈桿。
cats.notes: 上一位設計師做的，放大檢查沒問題，沒改。夜光只落在實際畫出的燈具和警示燈上。

cats.name: 氣象站
cats.v1: 加高：屋頂加一間玻璃觀測艙，桅桿延伸到雷達掛點，地面加百葉箱和雨量筒。
cats.v2: 重畫成低矮觀測小屋，後面是獨立的紅白格構氣象桅（桅頂就是雷達掛點），屋頂有雷達罩，另有風速計桿、百葉箱和雨量筒。
cats.notes: 精靈圖走通用的 vdraw574 那一行，但繪製端會在固定畫布座標 (36,34) 疊雷達動畫，所以兩個變體的畫布尺寸和錨點都沒動，桅頂也對準 (36,34)。若之後有人改這類的畫布尺寸，雷達會錯位。上一位設計師做的，檢查後沒改。

cats.name: 天文台
cats.v1: 大型單圓頂：粗壯的白色鼓座，開縫大穹頂伸出斜向鏡筒，東側一棟辦公附屋。
cats.v2: 雙圓頂觀測站：一棟長條研究樓，屋頂上一大一小兩座開縫圓頂，另有天線桿。
cats.notes: 上一位設計師做的。我小修 v1：鏡筒原本是幾塊斷開的方塊，改成連續的斜筒；鼓座和穹頂之間的環線加深，讓分界看得出來。v0 本身是飄在地塊後方的平面圖，變體是落地的等距圖，並排時高度差很大（v0 比較高）。

cats.name: 科技園
cats.v1: 環形總部：兩層玻璃環樓（矮胖），屋頂一圈太陽能板，中庭有綠地、樹和雕塑，正門有雨庇，東角有通訊桅。
cats.v2: 垂直研發塔：11 層玻璃塔（高瘦，塔頂有太陽能板、機房和天線），旁邊是鋸齒天窗實驗廠房，前方有太陽能車棚，後方綠地上有衛星碟。
cats.notes: 這批新做的，v0 是平面立面圖所以重畫。身分元素都沿用 v0：淡藍玻璃、太陽能深藍、天線、衛星碟、夜間青色窗光。夜光只落在畫出來的窗帶和天窗玻璃上。一輪修正：v1 前方一棵樹壓在環樓底邊和地塊尖角上，已移到西側。v2 車棚下的車幾乎都被棚頂擋住，不太看得到。

cats.name: 數據中心
cats.v1: 水平機房長廊：長條低矮機房，屋頂一排排風扇，另有單座冷卻槽和柴油發電貨櫃，牆面有 LED 帶。
cats.v2: 垂直機房塔：高聳無窗塔樓，有直向散熱百葉和角柱 LED 燈帶，東側三座冷卻器，西角有變電設備。
cats.notes: 上一位設計師做的（v0 是 T555 的簡單剪影，所以重畫），檢查後沒改。v2 塔在夜間很暗，只有 LED 燈帶，這是刻意的。

cats.name: 圖書總館
cats.v1: 新古典：屋頂中央換成鼓座大穹頂閱覽室加燈籠亭，左立面加上有山花的柱廊。
cats.v2: 書塔：屋頂中央升起一座高瘦的哥德式藏書塔，有尖錐頂、角尖塔和拱窗。
cats.notes: 上一位設計師做的，沒改。v1 的柱廊後面仍隱約露出 v0 左立面的窗，山花也比較不明顯。v2 書塔很高，是刻意的高低對比。

problems: 上一位設計師的檔案沒有整檔重寫：8 類保留（其中 84、68 小修），補上缺的 113、108、109。
113、108、109、84、68、116 的 v0 是平面立面圖或簡單剪影，這幾類的變體都是等距重畫（佔地、錨點和地塊色與 v0 一致）。同一城市裡 v0 平面圖和變體等距圖會混著出現，畫風一致性由整合者判斷。
k46 繪製端在固定畫布座標 (36,34) 疊雷達動畫，變體沒改畫布尺寸也對準了掛點；日後若改這類的畫布，雷達會錯位。
中途的迭代圖是 b04_r2_iter1 到 iter7；上一位設計師的 b04_iter0 到 iter3 保留沒動。

cats.name: 綜合醫院
cats.v1: East-side ward tower added behind the main block: 100px-tall white tower with rows of windows, a red cross sign and a rooftop helipad with its markings and red lights.
cats.v2: Old red-brick courtyard campus: two brick wings with gable roofs, arched windows and chimneys wrap the main block into a U shape.
cats.notes: Inherited from the previous designer and kept unchanged. I reviewed it twice. Both variants are 208x220 with the same anchor as v0, and the v0 main block plus its roof items are stamped back on top. On the v2 wing gables only one or two windows light up at night, so it is fairly dark.

cats.name: 樂齡中心
cats.v1: Long, low single-storey house: the gable end faces right, a row of wooden posts carries a lean-to veranda along the whole left wall, and there is a flower planter, a bench and a small tree out front.
cats.v2: Two-storey care home: green hip roof, a floor band between storeys, an entrance canopy with a ramp and handrail running along the wall, and a glass sunroom on the right side.
cats.notes: Added in this round. v0 is a flat front elevation, so I redrew it in isometric on the same tile footprint, keeping v0's beige walls, dark green roof, blue windows and outline colour. The shadow ellipse, left-edge light and grain follow the polishAll526 method, as batch b04 did. Night lights sit only on windows, doors and the sunroom glass. v1's veranda roof hides most of the wall, so at small size it mostly reads as roof. The ramp handrail on v2 is thin and hard to see.

cats.name: 寵物醫院
cats.v1: Flat-roofed clinic with the same grey-green cornice as v0: green cross lightbox on the roof, a big paw print on the right wall, a green door awning, and a white-fenced dog run at the back left with a doghouse, hurdle and water bowl.
cats.v2: Two-storey house-shaped hospital with a steep green gable roof: paw emblem and small window on the gable, a green cross sign sticking out from the left wall, and a low kennel wing on the right with high windows and skylights.
cats.notes: Added in this round. The first fence was drawn with thin lines and turned into a noisy grid, so I replaced it with a solid 3px plank band. The doghouse is only half visible behind the fence. The paw emblem on v2's gable is small and hard to make out at 1x.

cats.name: 銀行
cats.v1: Wide, fat domed bank: square stone base, a four-column portico with a pediment and gold medallion on the left wall, and a drum with a sampled domed roof in the centre topped by a gold lantern.
cats.v2: Tall, thin modern bank: a stone tower with vertical window strips, a gold crown band and a gold coin emblem, a low glass banking hall in front, and a drive-through ATM canopy on the right.
cats.notes: Added in this round. v0's gold and stone-grey palette is kept, and both variants have a gold coin or medallion. The dome is sampled point by point with backface culling and a 5-step tone ramp, so it has no stray pixels. Night lights cover only the drum windows, the tower window strips, the hall glass, the lantern and the ATM screen.

cats.name: 住宅巨廈
cats.v1: Three towers of different heights on the same podium, with rooftop gardens and a sky bridge crossing in front of the main tower between the two front towers.
cats.v2: Cascading slab: five stepped setbacks drop toward the front left, each step with a planted terrace and railing.
cats.notes: Inherited redraw. Fixed this round: the old sky bridges were completely hidden behind the front towers (dead pixels). I removed them and added one visible bridge. I also removed a flat dark rectangle in mbox that stuck out at the building's southern point. Problems: both variants have much more pixel area than v0 (43.9k and 45.8k vs 29.2k) and read heavier and much brighter at night. v0's low fence in front of the podium (a flat-rectangle artifact) is not carried over.

cats.name: 商業綜合體
cats.v1: Twin glass towers: each has a stepped crown and a spire, and a horizontal sky bridge links them.
cats.v2: Art Deco setback tower in warm stone: four stepped tiers with gold bands, a neon sign on the setback terrace and a spire.
cats.notes: Inherited redraw. Fixed this round: mbox drew the shop band as a flat rectangle, which left an orange-and-black wedge sticking out at the podium's southern point. It now follows the wall slope column by column, with a shopfront band and night-lit glass. Problem: the variants are much larger than v0's thin needle tower (47.0k and 35.6k vs 22.6k pixels), so they are much heavier in the skyline.

cats.name: 大型購物中心
cats.v1: A 156px-tall cream office tower with a red cornice band and stepped crown rises behind the right wing.
cats.v2: A Ferris wheel with an A-frame stand sits on the left wing roof, and an LED billboard on legs stands on the right wing roof.
cats.notes: Inherited and kept unchanged. I reviewed it twice. The Ferris wheel is large and dominates the silhouette, but its legs land on the wing roof, so nothing floats.

cats.name: 會展中心
cats.v1: A second hall with a barrel-vault roof along the northwest side: the gable end has a glass fan window, an entrance door and a banner.
cats.v2: A domed exhibition hall with a drum of glass windows on the east side, and a tall pylon on the west with a vertical banner and a lightbox.
cats.notes: Inherited and kept unchanged. I reviewed it twice. The vault's far end, near the main building's glass roof, has a few pixels that overlap v0's rooftop equipment, but it reads normally at 1x.

cats.name: 農貿市場
cats.v1: An open steel-frame shed with a corrugated gable roof covers the original stalls, with lamps hanging under the eaves.
cats.v2: A two-storey red-tiled market hall on the northwest side: ground-floor arcade, arched upper windows, a sign on the gable and a ridge vent. The front stalls and produce crates are kept.
cats.notes: Inherited. Fixed this round: in v2 the hall hides v0's middle green stall, which left the right end of its awning and a string light floating beside the hall (day and night). Those pixels are now cleared, while the hall's own pixels and the orange stall are kept. The white price tag above the orange stall is v0's own design and was left as is.

cats.name: 賞鯨台（batches.json 誤標為節慶市集）
cats.v1: Tall stilted lookout tower: four legs with diagonal bracing, a platform with railings, a rust-red pyramid roof with a lantern, a telescope on the platform, a stair and a boardwalk approach, plus a small whale-tail sculpture at front right.
cats.v2: Low, wide boardwalk scene: a boardwalk runs the full tile, entered through a pair of ivory whale-jawbone arches with a lamp hanging at the top; a teal ticket kiosk with a whale sign sits on the left, and two coin-op telescopes stand behind.
cats.notes: Added in this round. batches.json names k185 '節慶市集' (festival market), but the generation code and the KNAME table show it is 185 '賞鯨台' (whale-watching deck); 節慶市集 is k184. I designed for the whale-watching deck. v0's tall whale tail is the identity cue, so v1 carries a small tail and v2 uses the whale jawbone arch and whale sign. v2 is much lower than v0. v1's stair is only thin lines and hard to see.

problems: batches.json has the wrong name for k185: it says 節慶市集 (festival market), but in index.html (KNAME table, line 1327, and the generation comment at line 6588) k185 is 賞鯨台 (whale-watching deck); 節慶市集 is k184. The variants were designed as a whale-watching deck.

k85, k102, k86 and k185 have flat front-elevation v0 sprites, so I redrew them in isometric (same approach as k84 in batch b04). The variants therefore look stylistically different from their own v0, though they match the rest of the city better.

The previous designer's k105 and k106 variants are much larger than v0 (pixel area 1.5–2x) and read much heavier and brighter at night. The detail density per area matches v0, but whoever integrates this should check that these megastructures don't take over the skyline.

Fixed during handover: in the shared mbox, the flat shop band and flat bottom rectangle stuck out as wedges at the building's southern point (k106 v1/v2). The old k105 v1 sky bridges were completely hidden (dead pixels). In k87 v2, the hidden green stall left pieces floating beside the hall. box() now rounds its coordinates to whole pixels to avoid anti-aliasing at half-pixel positions.

Errors are caught per category (and for the new ones per variant) and logged with console.error; t574.err in the final renders is empty and all 20 keys were produced. Final contact sheets were rendered at scale 2, 6 categories plus 4; 12 renders in total.

cats.name: 博物館
cats.approach: v1 compose (on the final v0); v2 redraw
cats.v1: Adds a drum and a large copper-green dome (with arched drum windows and a small lantern on top) over v0's box, plus a pedimented colonnade portico and steps on the right facade.
cats.v2: Low two-wing gallery with a taller central pavilion enclosing a forecourt, with a glass pyramid entrance in the middle and a flag on each side.
cats.notes: Kept the previous designer's version. I checked it twice (enlarged crop and final sheet) and changed nothing. Weak spot: v2's central pavilion is a plain cube with no windows. Night light is only on drawn windows and the pyramid glass.

cats.name: 劇院
cats.v1: Low wine-red auditorium with a tall stage fly tower behind it (now with pilaster ribs), a marquee canopy wrapping the corner, and a blade sign sticking out from the left facade above the roofline.
cats.v2: Opera house: arcaded stone foyer at the front, a taller hall behind it, and a copper-green dome on a gold ring.
cats.notes: Changed this round: v1's vertical sign sat flat against the roof and read like paint, so I rebuilt it as a blade sign on the left facade that rises past the wall top. The fly tower's plain faces got pilaster ribs. The fly tower is still a fairly large simple mass. v2 unchanged.

cats.name: 水族館
cats.v1: A lattice glass ocean dome rises behind v0's building, with its lower half hidden by the building.
cats.v2: A tall cylindrical fish tank on steel rings (with fish shadows) at the right rear corner, plus a small sea lion pool on the left.
cats.notes: Changed this round: night glow was too strong. The dome's glass glow went from .30 to .18 and the tank column from .60 to .34, so light stays inside the drawn glass or water. The seal pool on v2 is small and reads weakly.

cats.name: 電影院
cats.v1: Tall, narrow purple multiplex with a tilted billboard on the roof, a corner bulb sign, and a marquee canopy wrapping the corner.
cats.v2: Short, wide cream Art Deco cinema with a three-step tower and teal sign at the south corner, plus a rounded canopy.
cats.notes: Kept the previous designer's version. I checked it twice and changed nothing.

cats.name: 動物園
cats.v1: African savanna zoo: thatch-roofed gate and ticket booth on the southwest edge; a rock outcrop with lions at the back; a giraffe grassland with an acacia at left front; an elephant pool with an adult and calf at right front; a round thatched restaurant on the right; lamp posts in the plaza.
cats.v2: City zoo: large mesh-dome aviary at the back (trees, flamingos and birds visible inside), a monkey island in a moat on the right, a red-brick animal house with arched windows and a glass lantern at left front, a penguin pool at the front, and a stone gateway with a plaque and baby-elephant statue on the southeast edge.
cats.notes: New this round, three render-and-fix passes. The gate was too big and blocked the paddock, so I shrank it. Outlined lamp posts turned into thick black bars, so lamps are now drawn straight onto the base layer. Paired lamp posts lined up into one tall pole, so I moved them apart. The elephant sprite was redrawn with ears, trunk and tusks. The v2 gate looked like a slab, so it became piers plus a lintel. Weak spots: the statue on the v2 gate is barely visible. v0 itself is very sparse, so both variants carry more pieces than v0, but each is a large readable object with no pixel noise. Night light is only on lamps, lanterns and windows.

cats.name: 遊樂園
cats.v1: Coaster park: a red steel coaster across the back half (lift hill, vertical loop, white supports, and a striped station canopy with a train); a purple-and-yellow circus big top at left front; three striped snack stalls in an L near the south; a rainbow bulb arch with balloon clusters at the entrance on the southwest edge.
cats.v2: Fairy-tale castle park: pink castle at the back with four corner towers, a central keep and blue cone roofs; a drop tower on the right rear; a swing ride at left front; a swan-boat lake at the front; small castle-turret gate towers on the southeast edge.
cats.notes: New this round, three render-and-fix passes. v1's gate overlapped the big top, so I moved the main path, gate and stalls. Removed a stray tree that had only a trunk. Moved the lift to widen the V between lift hill and drop. Thinned supports from every 4 to every 6 samples, and moved trees that crowded the gate. Weak spots: v1's lift hill and first drop still form a narrow V, and the gate's balloons sit a little crowded. v2 is the strongest one.

cats.name: 摩天輪
cats.approach: redraw (both); canvas 72x124, ay=117 (12px added on top)
cats.v1: Large truss Ferris wheel: double-ring rim, spokes, eight colored cabins hanging from it, A-frame legs, and a boarding platform.
cats.v2: Smaller white modern observation wheel with capsule pods, standing on the roof of a glass ticket terminal.
cats.notes: Kept the previous designer's version. I checked it twice and changed nothing. Weak spot: v1's platform base, where the legs meet it, is a bit messy. The sprite selection path is the generic one, but index.html line 22021 has a night animation overlay: eight lights orbiting 28px above the anchor on a flat ellipse. It doesn't line up with v0's wheel either; on v1 it falls on the lower wheel, on v2 over the terminal roof. It's night-only and small, but the integrator should know.

cats.name: 旋轉木馬
cats.v1: Classic single-deck carousel: wooden deck with red-and-gold skirt, six horses, gold center pole, red-and-white striped cone canopy (attached to the pole, fixing v0's floating top).
cats.v2: Taller, slimmer double-decker carousel: two horse decks, a gold middle deck with a bulb string, and a blue-and-white striped pointed canopy.
cats.notes: Kept the previous designer's version. I checked it twice and changed nothing. Both variants are much fuller than v0 (v0's top floats above a small base); horses are small but readable. Line 22473 has an animation overlay: six beads orbiting 48px above the anchor. v1's canopy brim is 45px up, so they line up; v2's brim is 57px up, so the beads land on the upper horse deck. Acceptable.

cats.name: 水上樂園
cats.v1: Slide tower: open steel frame tower at the back with two orange decks and a teal pointed roof; a yellow straight speed slide into the big pool at left front (with lane rope); a blue S-curve tube slide into the splash pool at right; loungers, umbrellas and a striped snack kiosk at the front.
cats.v2: Indoor tropical hall: a low glass barrel-vault hall at the back (arch ribs, glazed end wall, glass band along the facade); an orange tube slide leaves the end wall, loops, and lands in a free-form beach lagoon at the front; palms and thatch parasols.
cats.notes: New this round, two render-and-fix passes. In v2 the palms and parasols hid the slide loop, so I moved them. Pools and lagoon glow fully at night, same as v0. Weak spots: the v2 slide loop reads more like an S, and the thatch parasols look a bit like mushrooms.

cats.name: 星空露營區（batches.json 寫成海豚灣劇場，實為 KNAME[182]=星空露營區）
cats.v1: Glamping: a large bell tent on a wooden deck, string lights running to a lamp post, a campfire and wooden benches.
cats.v2: Stargazing cabin: steep A-frame with a big triangular window, a side deck with a telescope, and a small campfire.
cats.notes: Kept the previous designer's version. I checked it twice and changed nothing. Line 22224 has a night overlay: campfire glow 4px above the anchor. Both variants' campfires sit 5 to 8px above the anchor, so they line up.

problems: batches.json has the wrong name for k182 ('海豚灣劇場'). In index.html, KNAME[182]='星空露營區' (tool glampsite); 海豚灣劇場 is k181. I designed it as the campsite.

None of the ten categories has a custom sprite-selection path (all use the generic vdraw574 line at 24430). But k76, k80 and k182 have night animation overlays in drawNightLandmarks413 (lines 22021, 22473, 22224) with coordinates fixed to one v0 layout. k76's overlay is already off even on v0; k80's v2 and k76's variants don't line up with the beads/lights. It's night-only, but worth checking at integration.
k76 variant canvases are 72x124 with ay=117 (v0 is 72x112, ay=105). The anchor stays on the same ground spot, but diffVsV0 reports 'size'.

To inspect details I used inline PowerShell System.Drawing to crop and enlarge the variant-sheet PNGs into the scratchpad (no .ps1 files, no screen capture, no input). I also kept one backup copy of the batch file in the scratchpad.

The existing k35/36/37/40/76/80/182 drafts from the previous designer were mostly kept. This round only changed k36 v1 (sign and fly tower) and k37's night glow strength; k38/k39/101 were missing and are new.

cats.name: 鐘樓
cats.v1: 哥德式細高鐘樓：開放鐘室（看得到金鐘）、銅綠尖錐加四角小尖塔，右前方加一座紅瓦山牆小禮拜堂側翼和一盞前燈（72×128）。
cats.v2: 紅磚粗壯鐘樓：石隅角、底層雙拱廊、中段拱窗、雙大鐘盤，頂上八角燈亭加銅綠圓頂（72×118）。
cats.notes: 沿用上一位設計師的半成品，沒有改。放大 3 倍檢查過日夜兩張：兩個變體輪廓（細高尖塔對粗壯圓頂）、材質（白石對紅磚）都不同，沒有浮空或裁切。夜光落在鐘盤、金鐘、禮拜堂窗和拱廊燈上。v2 右面拱廊開口白天沒畫燈，夜裡有微弱的室內光，算是開口透光，但嚴格說有點擦邊。

cats.name: 紀念碑
cats.v1: 勝利紀念柱：三層台階、方座嵌金銘牌、高圓柱加柱頭，頂上鍍金展翼勝利女神，兩盞前燈（72×128）。
cats.v2: 寬低廣場台上放長方基座（金銘牌），上面是青銅騎馬像（近側前蹄抬起、騎士舉劍），兩角各一根燈柱。
cats.notes: 本輪重畫了 v2 的騎馬像：原本的馬頭是一團、騎士只是一根棒子。新增 spanSprite 工具，用逐列區段畫，部件交界自動受光分件；放大後馬、騎士、劍都讀得出來，蹄底落在基座頂面上。v1 沒改。夜裡銘牌發光是照 v0 的做法。另外 v0 的 ay=105，但它的地坪畫到接近 y110；變體的佔地南頂點精確落在 ay=110，所以遊戲裡變體地坪會比 v0 高約 5px。

cats.name: 觀景塔
cats.v1: 白色三段收分觀測塔：外挑觀景廊、環窗觀測室，頂部圓頂伸出望遠鏡（比 v0 那座矮台上的望遠鏡高很多）。
cats.v2: 電波望遠鏡站：低矮白台基上立基座塔、叉架、大型拋物面天線加饋源支架，右前方有一間帶小天線的控制小屋。
cats.notes: 沒有改。工具名是 skytower／觀景塔，圖示是📡，v0 畫的是矮台上的望遠鏡，所以 v1 走「望遠鏡觀景塔」、v2 走「電波天線」，身分都還在天文觀測這條線上。夜光落在環窗、觀測縫、控制小屋窗和饋源紅燈上。

cats.name: 凱旋門
cats.v1: 古典單拱凱旋門：厚重低寬的量體，半圓大拱看得穿、裡面有側牆和地坪，雙壁柱、右面側小拱、齒飾橫帶加刻字女兒牆，拱心懸一盞燈。
cats.v2: 不鏽鋼懸鏈線拱門：沿格子東西對角正對觀者，底粗頂細，三角斷面外亮內暗，拱頂有觀景窗；底下是花崗岩廣場台，拱後一塊草坪，前方水鏡池，拱腳內側有投光燈。
cats.notes: 本輪重畫了 v2。原本的中空方框巨門放大看像一台打開的櫃子，所以換成高瘦的單曲線鋼拱，和 v0 的小門樓、v1 的厚重古典拱輪廓完全不同。掃描確認拱內沒有雜點、拱腳落在台面上並加了接地陰影。夜光只有拱頂窗、投光燈，加上拱腳內側一條很淡的投光（有燈具才有）。v2 本來就是細線輪廓，像素密度刻意比 v0 低。v0 的 ay=100 但地坪畫到約 y111；變體南頂點在 ay=110，遊戲裡變體地坪會比 v0 高約 10px。

cats.name: 電視塔
cats.v1: 四腳展開式紅白鐵塔：四腳跨在基座樓上，中段有觀景平台（窗帶），上段收分桁架加天線，斜撐線（72×132）。
cats.v2: 拉索桅杆塔：極細紅白桅杆，三向拉索拉到地錨，側邊一間機房，屋頂有碟形天線（72×132）。
cats.notes: 沒有改，兩輪檢查都通過。胖（四腳鐵塔）對瘦（單桅拉索）差異明確。拉索和斜撐是描邊後才畫的半透明線，不會被描粗。夜光落在觀景平台窗、機房窗和航空警示燈上。

cats.name: 天際觀景餐廳
cats.v1: 細腰針塔：玻璃入口圓亭、收腰塔身帶膠囊電梯，頂上大飛碟餐廳帶環窗，最上面一根桅杆，比 v0 高一截（72×136）。
cats.v2: 矮胖旋轉餐廳：兩層玻璃商場裙樓（屋頂有花台）、粗混凝土筒身帶觀光電梯縫，上下兩層玻璃圓鼓，頂上一根天線。
cats.notes: 沒有改，兩輪檢查都通過。高瘦針塔對矮胖雙鼓加裙樓，結構差異明確。夜光落在環窗、裙樓窗、入口和電梯縫上。

cats.name: 噴泉廣場
cats.v1: 低矮橢圓大池（矮石緣），中央台座上一尊著袍女像把水瓶夾在腰側、瓶口向右下傾水，兩側各一道拱形水柱，池畔兩盞燈。
cats.v2: 方形階池套內高台池，中央立金頂方尖碑（四面吐水），兩角各一個絲柏花箱。
cats.notes: 本輪重畫了 v1 的雕像：原本看起來像水龍頭，改成用逐列區段畫的著袍女像。v1 的夜間池面光暈原本比 v0 大很多，已縮到和 v0 同量級。v2 沒改。已知問題（改不了）：index.html 的疊加層（k===71 那段，約 22696 行）在畫面固定位置畫兩隻池沿小鳥，換算到素材座標約 (28/44, ay-46)。對 v0（ay=100）大約落在中層水盤；對變體（ay=110）會浮在 v1 雕像或 v2 方尖碑旁的半空。另外 v0 的 ay=100，變體地坪會比 v0 高約 10px。

cats.name: 節慶市集
cats.v1: 紅白條紋方錐大帳篷（開口看得到攤貨，頂上有旗），兩根柱子拉燈籠串，左前一個藍色遮陽攤，右前貨箱。
cats.v2: 四柱三間紅牌樓夜市：中高側低的歇山瓦頂加金匾，燈籠分掛三間，左前紅白傘攤，右前幡旗和貨箱。
cats.notes: 本輪修了一處：兩個變體的左前攤位原本和後方條紋帳篷、紅柱在同一層描邊，放大後混成一團。現在攤位改成獨立一層先描邊再疊上去，分件清楚了。燈籠 x20/30/40/50、y80 和左前攤檯位置都照 v0，好讓 drawNightFestival517 的燈籠光和攤檯暖光落在實體燈具上；左柱頂也接得上疊加層的風旗。v2 牌樓的細節密度略高於 v0，還在可接受範圍，請整合者再看一眼。

cats.name: 熱氣球基地
cats.v1: 橫帶彩虹淚滴熱氣球（梨形加經線縫），吊籃燃燒器配雙繫留繩，圓木升空坪，右後一座山牆機庫，另有風向袋和燃料罐；夜裡只有燃燒器照亮球體下半。
cats.v2: 繫留氦氣球遊覽站：網格圓球帶赤道紅帶，下掛環形吊艙和單纜絞盤，圓形起降環有護欄，左前一座售票亭。
cats.notes: 沒有改，兩輪檢查都通過。兩個變體的球心都留在疊加層呼吸光暈的位置（素材約 (36,52)）。小瑕疵：v1 機庫的金屬屋面放大 4 倍時看起來略平。v2 球體本身夜裡不發光，只有吊艙窗、頂燈和售票亭窗亮；但疊加層仍會在球心畫光暈。

cats.name: 夜光花園
cats.v1: 石基八角玻璃溫室（白框穹頂加小燈亭，看得到裡面的綠植），前方兩座彎月花床、一條石徑、兩盞螢光柱燈。
cats.v2: 白粉牆轉角庭園：沿西北、東北兩緣的 L 形白粉牆加黛瓦壓頂，東北牆開月洞門看得到竹影，西北牆有方形漏窗；牆角一棵圓冠樹，左前荷塘有蓮燈，右前石燈籠，踏石徑通往月洞門，牆腳一排螢光花。
cats.notes: 本輪重畫了 v2：原本單片短牆兩端突然截斷，看起來像廣告看板，改成沿兩條後緣的 L 形圍牆，讀起來是圍合的庭院。石燈籠和花的位置也調過，避免夜光糊成一團。三個版本的差異：v0 開放花圃、v1 中央溫室、v2 圍合庭院。index.html 疊加層的兩個花海光暈原本就畫在素材下緣之外，和變體無關。

problems: k71：index.html 的日間疊加層（k===71、sea!==3，約 22696 行）把兩隻池沿小鳥畫在固定位置（素材約 (28/44, ay-46)）。對 v0（ay=100）大致落在水盤上，但對 v1 雕像池和 v2 方尖碑（ay=110）會浮在半空。只改批次檔修不了，需要整合時調整疊加層或接受。
k72/k75/k71 的 v0 素材 ay 是 105/100/100，但地坪美術畫到接近 y110。變體照規格把佔地南頂點放在 ay=110，所以遊戲裡同一格的變體地坪會比 v0 高約 5–10px。變體的位置才是對的，偏的是 v0。
接手時確認上一位設計師已完成全部 10 類，檔案可執行，保留沿用。本輪重畫或修正的是：k75 v2（改成鋼拱）、k186 v2（改成 L 形圍牆庭院）、k72 v2 騎馬像、k71 v1 雕像與夜光、k184 兩個變體的攤位分層描邊。其餘 5 類（67/73/89/103/180）兩輪檢查後沒改。
過程中有一條 shell 指令誤用 `python -` 加 heredoc 而卡住，已用 TaskStop 停掉，並確認批次檔沒被寫入；之後所有修改都改用 Edit 工具，每次改完都跑 node --check 通過。
k184 v2 牌樓的細節密度略高於 v0，還在可接受範圍，建議整合時再看一眼。

cats.name: 植物園
cats.v1: Victorian palm house: a long glass barrel-vault greenhouse with a white iron frame, a central glass dome with a lantern and an entrance porch at the back, and in front a four-bed formal flower garden with a central fountain, clipped cone trees and palms.
cats.v2: Eco domes: two overlapping geodesic glass domes with a triangular grid at the back, a timber visitor centre with a green roof, a water-lily pond with a zigzag boardwalk front right, and three stepped flower terraces front left.
cats.notes: Added this session. At runtime v0 is only a narrow glass column on a bare plate, so it is very simple. Both variants are full 3x3 redraws with about 7-12% more pixels than v0, which means they look much richer than v0; the owner should decide whether that mismatch is acceptable. Night light is limited to the glass walls, the dome shape, the visitor-centre windows and the lamps. I removed trees behind the building that were poking above the roof outline.

cats.name: 體育園區
cats.v1: Athletics stadium: a red running track with lane lines around a striped football pitch (goals and centre circle), a three-tier stand at the back with a cantilever roof and spectators, a scoreboard at the west end, and three floodlight towers.
cats.v2: Baseball field plus arched gym: a fan-shaped outfield with a green wall and yellow top line, a clay infield with bases and pitcher's mound, a see-through backstop behind home plate, dugouts on both sides, an indoor hall at the back right with a barrel-vault metal roof and high side windows, a scoreboard back left, and two floodlight towers.
cats.notes: Added this session. v0 is flat, square-on courts, and both variants are structurally different from it and from each other. First render failed: a local constant named HL shadowed hashLocal479. Fixed. On v2 I moved the back trees in front of the gym in draw order so they no longer sit on its roof, lightened the backstop net, and changed the white players, who looked like posts, to blue.

cats.name: 涼亭
cats.v1: Double-eaved octagonal pavilion: two-step stone platform with front steps, eight red columns with bench railings, grey-blue glazed curved roof in two tiers with ridge lines and upturned corners, gold gourd finial, red lantern at the front, small pine behind.
cats.v2: Wisteria pergola with square pavilion: a timber pavilion back right with a four-slope roof, a long pergola running to the front left (beams, slats, hanging purple wisteria) with a bench underneath, a small pond, stepping stones and a street lamp.
cats.notes: Added this session. v0 has ay=105 but draws its plate at ay-14, so the plate sits about half a tile low and is cut off by the bottom of the canvas. The variants follow the contract and put the plate's south corner at (36,110), so in the city v0 and the variants sit at different heights. v1 is much taller than the very low v0 (tall/short contrast by design). I lowered v1's upper roof tier once so it reads less like a pagoda.

cats.name: 古樹神木
cats.v1: Old banyan: wide umbrella canopy, hanging aerial roots, stone ring around the base, red cloth tied round the trunk, a small red-roofed earth-god shrine back left and a stone lamp front right.
cats.v2: Leaning old pine: a pine growing at a slant from a mossy mound, with flat cloud-like foliage pads, wooden forked props under the long branches, a straw rope on the trunk, stone posts linked by rope along the front, a stone tablet and a stone lamp.
cats.notes: Added this session. v0 has ay=100 and its plate is also drawn at ay-14; the variants put the south corner at (36,110), so the position differs from v0 as with k74. v1 has about 44% more pixels than v0 because the canopy is wide, but the detail level is similar (large areas of tree shading, no busy texture). At night only the shrine and stone lamps light up.

cats.name: 遛狗公園
cats.v1: Dog agility yard: wooden fence all round with a gate and sign, A-frame, two jump bars, blue tunnel, dogs and handler, street lamp.
cats.v2: Shaded dog rest park: hedge along the back, red-tiled shelter with bench, big tree, paddling pool, drinking fountain, two-post entrance and lamp.
cats.notes: Drawn by the previous designer; I reviewed it at 2x zoom and kept it unchanged. The fences are a little dark and crowded, but it reads correctly as a dog park.

cats.name: 溜冰場
cats.v1: Standard ice-hockey rink: rink with cut corners (lines and goals), blue-roofed arena building back left, two floodlight towers, skaters.
cats.v2: Ring skating path: a loop of ice round a central island, a red-and-white cone-roofed skate-rental kiosk, two lamp posts, skaters.
cats.notes: Drawn by the previous designer; reviewed and kept. v2's red-and-white striped cone kiosk looks a bit like a carousel or circus tent, but the rink itself still reads correctly.

cats.name: 滑板公園
cats.v1: Tall U-shaped half-pipe running along one axis, with platforms on both sides, metal coping, graffiti on the front deck, a back railing, a skater, a bench and a lamp.
cats.v2: Street-style plaza: graffiti wall, funbox with rail plus ramp, three steps with a handrail, skaters, a small tree in the corner and a lamp.
cats.notes: Drawn by the previous designer; reviewed. I removed one tree from v1 because its crown was poking above the ramp platform and looked like a bush on the deck. In v2 the tree behind the back wall reads as growing behind it, so I kept it.

cats.name: 游泳池
cats.v1: Competition lap pool with lane ropes and starting blocks, changing building at the back, three-level diving tower in the east corner.
cats.v2: Leisure pool: free-form pool, spiral water-slide tower with red roof, parasol and loungers.
cats.notes: Drawn by the previous designer; reviewed and kept. Weak spot: at 1x, v1's diving tower is a narrow white block with stepped platforms, and its outline does not clearly read as a diving tower.

cats.name: 中央公園
cats.v1: Big lake park: irregular lake, small pavilion on an island, stone arch bridge, wooden jetty with rowing boats and a boat-rental kiosk on the front shore, path round the lake, ring of trees, benches and street lamps.
cats.v2: Hill lookout park: man-made hill at the back with a spiral path to a white lookout tower (lit windows, green pyramid roof, flag), cherry trees, children's playground front left (sandpit, swings, slide), round rose garden with sundial front right, picnic blanket, benches and lamps.
cats.notes: Added this session. v0 is an X of paths with a pond and a bandshell; both variants use a completely different layout and silhouette. Second pass: narrowed the jetty planks, removed a tree that hid the rental kiosk, and moved lamp posts that looked as if they stood in the lake or in front of the rose garden.

cats.name: 水舞光泉
cats.v1: Tiered classical fountain: round stone basin, two raised catch bowls with falling water, a centre spout and four lamp posts.
cats.v2: Modern dry-fountain plaza: wet stone paving with floor jets, a tall centre water jet, an L-shaped granite seat wall and two LED light columns.
cats.notes: Drawn by the previous designer; I made two fixes. (1) v1's top spout was floating with a gap of about 8px above the bowl, so I added a stone stem to connect it. (2) v2's stainless-steel ring sculpture was busy and noisy, so I removed it; the plaza is now cleaner and less dense than v0. Both variants keep the main water jet at x=36 with the pool below, lining up with the nighttime colour-cycling water-column overlay drawNightFestival517 draws for this building type.

cats.name: 水塔景觀
cats.v1: Riveted steel spherical water tower: four splayed legs with X-bracing, central riser with ladder, ring walkway round the middle, orange town-colour band and a red aviation light on top.
cats.v2: Historic red-brick water tower: round brick shaft with arched windows and stone bands, corbelled brackets, cream tank level with a round window, slate cone roof, lantern turret and weathervane.
cats.notes: Drawn by the previous designer; reviewed and kept. Runtime v0 looks more like a grey sphere machine than a water tower; both variants are real water towers and much taller than v0. v0 has ay=108 with its plate drawn at ay-14; the variants put the south corner at (36,110).

cats.name: 天燈廣場
cats.v1: Lantern launch terrace: square stone terrace with courses and railing, three steps on the front left, three poles at the back strung with lantern lines, a charcoal basin in the middle with a sky lantern ready to launch, and two people launching it; stone lamps on both sides of the plaza.
cats.v2: Giant sky-lantern sculpture: a large paper lantern, wider at the top, on a stone plinth in a round paved area, with red ribs and a lucky-diamond emblem, a wishing-plaque rack back right, a small tiled-roof lantern stall back left, and stone lamps.
cats.notes: Added this session. v0 is a three-roof open frame tower; v1 is low and wide, v2 is a single large sculpture. The launch point stays near centre x=36, y<=85, lining up with drawNightFestival517's rising sky lanterns at runtime. Second pass: raised v1's terrace and added railings and bigger lanterns; redrew v2's lantern from a square pillar into a sky-lantern shape and turned down its night glow.

problems: Anchor mismatch (pre-existing v0 issue): runtime v0 of k74 (ay=105), k78 (ay=100) and k77 (ay=108) draws its plate with dia(ax,ay-14,32), so the plate sits 14-18px low and the bottom of the canvas cuts it off. All variants follow the contract, with the south corner at (36,110) on a 72x112 canvas, so in the city v0 and the variants of these three types sit at different heights. The integrator should decide whether to fix v0.

Inside put(), each variant's day image gets a replay of T526 polish (edge highlight, grain, contact-shadow ellipse) and T479 material, which the previous designer copied line by line with a deterministic hash. The T541 night-window warm halo is not replayed, so variant night images lack it; if T526/T479 ever change, this copy must be updated too.
Every variant in the batch is a redraw with no shared random numbers (only A.hashLocal479, catmull and fixed coordinates).
For k47 the runtime v0 is extremely simple (a narrow glass column), and both 3x3 variants are much richer, so a city will show a visible quality gap between one-third v0 and two-thirds variants.
k96 v1's diving tower does not read clearly at 1x, and k93 v2's red-and-white rental kiosk looks a bit like a carousel. Both are readable, but I did not redo them.
k183 and k179 have k-based night overlays in drawNightFestival517 (runtime lights, not a custom draw path). Both variants keep the launch point or main water jet near the centre so they line up.

cats.name: 大農場
cats.v1: Dairy farm: the left plowed field and small red shed become a long isometric free-stall barn (red gable facing SW with a white X door and hayloft, open stalls with cow heads on the long side, metal gable roof with two vents), with wrapped round bales in front, and the orchard corner becomes a white-fenced pasture with cows and a trough.
cats.v2: Grain farm: the orchard corner becomes a concrete pad with three galvanized cone-roof bins, a tall bucket elevator with spouts and a grain truck; the left field gets a half-round steel equipment shed with a green tractor inside.
cats.notes: Rewrote v1 this round. The inherited v1 put a flat, front-view long barn plus cows on the front field, which broke the isometric axis. The index.html draw path runs T403 tractor animation along that front field, so it would have driven through the barn. v1 now leaves the front field alone and uses the left and right corners. Draw side is custom: at index.html around line 24411, k22/k53 take s=SPR.bld[bd.k+'_1_'+bd.v] and look up farmGrow/farmSea by that same key, never calling vdraw574. The integrator has to wire variant selection in, and seasonal/growth sprites only exist for _0, so v1/v2 won't change with the seasons. Both variants keep the v0 core (big barn, silo, house); the changes are local, so structural difference is moderate (diff about 4000px). No night image, same as v0.

cats.name: 溫室
cats.v1: Venlo multi-span glass greenhouse: long wide block with five sawtooth gables, a red-brick boiler house with tall chimney at back left, a gravel path and seedling trays in front; pink grow lights at night.
cats.v2: Victorian palm house: glass dome pavilion with ribs and lantern top, a curved-roof wing on each side with rows of arched windows, a pedimented porch and two lamp posts.
cats.notes: Kept the previous designer's version; checked it at 4x zoom and found no issues. Both variants are much bulkier than v0 (two small tunnels on a large plot), but detail density matches. The front view with a dark receding right side follows the batch's convention for this family. AGRI404 in the draw path only affects the plaza ring; the sprite goes through vdraw574.

cats.name: 風車
cats.v1: Stout stone tower mill: tapered stone tower on a stone base, wooden dome cap, X of two cloth and two lattice sails, arched door, and a small miller's hut on the left.
cats.v2: Tall, thin American water-pumping windmill: steel lattice tower, multi-blade wheel, red tail vane, pump pipe, wooden water tank and lantern post.
cats.notes: Fix this round: in v1 the upper-right sail tip and its outline touched the canvas edge at x=71, so I shortened the sails from 28 to 26 and the stocks from 30 to 28. Edge check now clean. Night light only sits on real windows and the lantern.

cats.name: 堆肥場
cats.v1: Three-bay compost shed: low steel roof over three concrete bays holding piles at different stages, a windrow in front and a small yellow loader.
cats.v2: Horizontal rotary drum composter: green drum on a stand with feed hopper, motor box, discharge pile, pallet of finished bags, and a control box light.
cats.notes: Kept as inherited; checked at zoom with no floating parts or clipping. At night v1 lights only the shed pendant lamp, and v2 lights the control box lamp and indicator.

cats.name: 社區菜園
cats.v1: Plastic polytunnel with two wooden-frame raised beds and a vine-covered arch holding a hanging lamp.
cats.v2: Pergola sitting corner with string lights, a bench and a raised bed, plus a tall rain-water tower and sunflowers.
cats.notes: Fix this round: the v2 sunflowers used to look like hollow yellow boxes, so I redrew them as round yellow heads with dark centers and added leaves. The v2 water tower is tall compared with v0; that is deliberate for the 'tall vs short' brief.

cats.name: 魚塘
cats.v1: Earth-bank square pond with a stilt keeper's hut, paddle-wheel aerator, net-pen frame and reeds.
cats.v2: Hatchery: two round rearing tanks, blue-roofed hatch shed and a raised water tower.
cats.notes: v2 reads less like a fish pond than v0 and v1 do, so this round I added a small orange fish and a dark fish shadow in each tank; still a weak spot. Night lights are only on the shed windows and the hut lamp.

cats.name: 民宿
cats.v1: Low, wide farmhouse B&B: long side-gabled house with two dormers, full-length wooden veranda, window boxes, chimney and a teal hanging sign.
cats.v2: Tall, thin Victorian tower B&B: round tower with cone roof, mansard roof with dormer, arched windows, bay window, porch and hanging sign.
cats.notes: Kept as inherited; checked at zoom with no issues. Night light only on windows, doors and the porch lamp.

cats.name: 商務旅館
cats.v1: Taller version: slim glass tower with vertical fins and a gold rooftop sign, a two-story podium with green roof hedges, and a red drop-off canopy.
cats.v2: Wide, low old red-brick hotel: projecting center bay, mansard roof with dormers, arched top-floor windows, stone ground floor with arched windows, bulb-lit entrance canopy and vertical sign.
cats.notes: Kept as inherited. Lit windows are picked with metroRand516 so the result is deterministic. Density is similar to v0.

cats.name: 度假酒店
cats.v1: Terraced resort: four stepped-back floors with continuous glazing and planter balconies, a pergola bar on the roof, a kidney-shaped pool, palms and parasols.
cats.v2: Low, spread-out water-villa village: open lobby under a big thatched roof, a lagoon, four stilt water huts, a boardwalk loop, sandbars and palms.
cats.notes: Kept as inherited. The v1 pool glows at night the same way v0's does. The v2 lagoon stays on the plot. v1 windows are fairly dense but at the same scale as v0's window rows.

cats.name: 青年旅舍
cats.v1: Tall, thin three-story backpacker building: rooftop terrace with railing, parasol and bunting, an external zigzag steel stair and a vertical backpack flag sign.
cats.v2: Container hostel: four offset stacked shipping containers with cantilevers on steel posts, a glass lobby and rooftop bunting.
cats.notes: Kept as inherited; checked at zoom with no floating parts. Night light only on windows and the bunting bulbs.

cats.name: 資源回收廠
cats.v1: Large sort-and-bale plant: tall sorting tower with the recycling emblem, a conveyor gallery over the roof, an unloading hall with three roller doors, and stacks of bales in three colors.
cats.v2: Glass and metal recycling yard: yellow gantry grab crane over three concrete bays (green glass, brown glass, scrap metal), two cone-bottom silos and a bucket elevator tower.
cats.notes: Kept as inherited. v2 has no recycling emblem; the sorted cullet piles and grab crane carry the identity. The elevator tower is close to the top of the canvas, but the edge check found no clipping.

problems: k53 uses its own draw path (index.html around line 24411, the k22/k53 crop-growth branch): it reads SPR.bld[bd.k+'_1_'+bd.v] and farmGrow/farmSea[...][fk] and never calls vdraw574. The integrator has to wire variants in, and 53_1_1/53_1_2 have no seasonal or growth sprites.

k53 T403 tractor animation (around index.html line 24772) runs along the front field at (164±38, 206±19). I kept the front field in v1/v2 for this reason; the inherited v1 had covered it with the barn and cows.
k120 v2 (hatchery) reads less like a fish pond than v0/v1; I only added small fish, so it is a weak spot.
Previous designer's file was usable and complete: kept 9 categories as they were, rewrote k53 v1, and made small fixes to k70 v1 (sails touched the canvas edge) and k104 v2 (sunflower shapes).

cats.name: 煉油廠
cats.approach: redraw（保留 v0 地坪下緣含 AO／工業色邊線，上半地坪依原參數重鋪，量體半解析重畫；煙囪／火炬頂端對齊 T364b 排氣口 raw 274,72）
cats.v1: 催化裂解擴建型：鋼構反應器架＋高低雙蒸餾塔＋白色反應塔＋格構高火炬＋兩顆球形 LPG 槽＋橫貫管架＋紅磚控制室。
cats.v2: 儲槽區老廠：防液堤內 2×2 浮頂儲槽、加熱爐房＋紅白高煙囪、兩根短塔、沿 j 管架、右前紅磚控制樓。
cats.notes: 這一輪修改：T364b 夜間暖帶在繪製端寫死在 raw (224..328, 268..278)，這是 v0 窗帶的位置。v1 在帶內的火炬格構和塔器平台補了 4 盞實體平台燈（白天看得到燈具），v2 在加熱爐房左面補一排高側窗，讓光有燈具可落。仍有缺點：這條光帶是水平矩形，等距量體只能部分對上，暖光有一段會照在空處。建議整合時對 v≠0 關掉暖帶，或改用各變體自己的座標。繪製走通用那一行，另有 FX 疊加（24662 行）。

cats.name: 鋼鐵廠
cats.approach: redraw（T516 industrial-kit 1× 畫布，同參數重鋪地坪，量體 1× 重畫）
cats.v1: 高爐一貫廠：格構塔架包住的分段高爐＋除塵器＋三座熱風爐＋斜皮帶廊接料倉＋山牆出鐵場（爐口有火光）＋兩堆礦石。
cats.v2: 電爐小鋼廠：高煉鋼廠房（天窗＋煙道）＋袋濾屋與短煙囪＋長條山牆軋鋼廠＋廢鋼堆與黃色門式吊車＋鋼胚堆。
cats.notes: 實機看不到：24431 行的 metroIndustrySprite516A 在都會美術開啟時，會把 122 強制換回有 __t516 標記的 canonical _0，整合時要放行變體鍵才看得到。這一輪沒有改美術，兩次看圖（上一輪定稿圖放大、iter3a 日夜）沒發現浮空、裁切或雜點。v2 的門式吊車線條偏細，份量略弱。

v1 在接觸表比例下讀成中世紀城堡：四角是帶圓錐頂的圓塔，加上垛口牆，監獄語彙（刺網、探照燈、牢房窗列）幾乎看不到；牆內的翼舍和中央圓廳也被前牆擋住，糊成一片。修法：四角圓塔改成方形混凝土崗樓，崗亭外挑、四坡平緩頂，拿掉圓錐尖頂；牆頂沿線加一道 1px 深色刺網加等距小點樁；每座崗亭朝內加一個探照燈頭（亮黃 2x2）；前牆降低 3–4px，讓後方牢房翼露出一排窄縫窗；中央圓廳頂和院子地面至少拉開 2 個色階。夜圖只亮探照燈頭和縫窗，不要加光錐。v2 通過。

v1 石砌圓塔加紅圓錐頂，接觸表上讀起來像燈塔或城堡塔樓，看不出瞭望亭：玻璃環和木托迴廊在白天幾乎沒有存在感，夜間塔頂也只有很弱的光。修法：v1 塔頂瞭望亭放寬，每側往外挑 3–4px，玻璃帶加高到 5–6px，用明顯的淺藍玻璃加深色窗框豎條；迴廊欄杆做成 1px 淺木色水平線，並有可見的托架；圓錐頂壓低成平緩的四坡或八角頂，避免尖塔感。夜圖讓整圈玻璃分格亮起（alpha 約 .6）。塔腳的工具棚放大到至少 10px 寬，加一個可辨識的斜頂和門。v2 通過。

review.overall: 32 類中 26 類通過、6 類退件：k79、k181、k50、k31、k95、k115。整體水準良好，大多數變體走的是結構差異（量體、高低胖瘦、年代語彙、附屬設施），不是刷色。夜圖大致守住了「先有燈具才有光」，沒看到憑空的大片光暈。最常見的退件原因是身分被新造型蓋過：鐘亭丟了碼頭線索、海豚劇場像帳篷或溫室、放射式監獄像城堡、石砌瞭望塔像燈塔、筒拱市民中心像機庫。其次是小變體太小太平，讀不出來（k50 露天礦坑）。另外兩個跨類提醒要交給整合者：k42 v1 畫布高度是 111，以及 k19、k62、k42 的變體依賴寫死的疊畫掛點。 || The three batches are generally good: 27 of 31 categories pass. Most variants change the structure itself (setbacks, wings, domes or towers, a new layout), not just colour. Line quality and lighting from the left match v0. The most common problem is that identity cues shrink too much in small redraws (k84 v1 and k185 read as an ordinary house or a generic lookout tower). Next most common is megastructures whose mass and night brightness are well above v0 (k105), plus a single large blank mass that looks unfinished (k35 v2 central pavilion). One more item for the integrator: in the redrawn categories, a flat v0 now sits alongside isometric variants, and the k76/k80 night-animation overlays do not line up with the variants. || Overall these three batches are good. 29 of the 33 types pass. Most variants are full redraws with clear structural differences (tall/thin vs short/wide, different layouts, different eras), and night light mostly follows the rule that light needs a fixture. Four types need fixes: k78 (the banyan's aerial roots read as pavilion columns and the pine's props read as fence posts), k93 v2 (reads as a carousel), k96 v1 (diving tower unreadable) and k120 v2 (the hatchery has lost its pond identity). The shared problem is small parts that do not read at 1x. The most common integration issues are not art: v0's ay does not match its plate (k71/72/75/74/77/78), so variants sit at different heights from v0; overlays are pinned to v0 positions (the k71 birds, the k180 v2 balloon glow); k53 takes a custom draw path and needs variants wired in by hand; and k47's v0 is far below its variants, so upgrading it separately is recommended. || b10 和 b11 共 21 類，整體水準高：幾乎每類的 v1、v2 都是結構層級的不同（量體、佈局、年代），身分清楚，夜光多半只落在白天畫出的燈具上。這一輪退 2 件。121 的 v1 地坪有接縫，前緣一塊偏亮的鋪面楔形帶著粗鋸齒邊界；131 的 v2 機庫門前車輛和貨櫃疊成一團。最常見的系統性問題不在變體本身：124–133 的 v0 是正立面圖，和等距變體混用時風格落差明顯，建議另開卡重畫 v0。122、123 要整合端放行 metroIndustrySprite516A，121 的 T364b 暖帶要改成依各變體座標，否則實機看不到變體或會漏光。

cats.notes: v1 退件逐條：(1) 海豚放大到 25×17px（要求 22–26），深藍灰背 #2c4a66、白腹 #f4f8fa，弧形躍出姿勢，有背鰭、胸鰭、眼睛。(2) 白色水花：在描邊和材質之後才畫（不然會被尾巴外框吃掉、被貼地影壓灰），做成水面冠狀弧加兩道上揚飛沫弧線，蓋在尾鰭前面。(3) 膜頂：舊版北角桅頂高 24，現在北角高 15；整個剪影的最高點從畫布 y≈56 降到 y≈63，約降 7px。膜頂改成平滑的兩個低峰（sin² 起伏，44 條細帶，依坡向分三階明暗），只罩後排，桅桿頂就停在膜面、不再冒出。第一次做成四片平板折頂，縮小看像兩個人字屋頂，所以重做。(4) 看台踏面改成藍色座椅，端面和踢面改混凝土灰，階梯才不會和白膜黏成一塊實心「帳篷」。浮球拿掉（會壓到海豚胸鰭），池壁水下燈移到東北池壁，避開海豚的投影範圍。v2 退件逐條：(1) 山牆頂加藍色海豚標誌 18×16px，尾鰭坐在灰色小座上、正好在山牆頂點，身體躍過屋脊線，縮小看剪影很醒目。(2) 浪紋腰帶改成 2px、週期 6px、振幅 1px 的波浪，用飽和藍（左面 #1a6cc0/#2f8ee6，右面 #145aa2/#2378cc）。(3) 噴泉雕像改成 13px 高的直立藍色海豚，放在加大的圓池中央石座上，吻部有噴水弧線。原本地面三道藍色短線是雜訊，已拿掉。(4) 夜圖：拱窗按窗櫺分成六格，只亮四格（按面積約 66%）；原本腰帶整條亮起的夜光帶已拿掉，因為那裡白天沒有燈具。夜光現在只在四格窗、三個舷窗、噴泉池緣兩顆燈上。兩個變體畫布都是 72×112，ax=36、ay=110。

cats.name: 礦場

cats.v2: (Redrawn this round) Open-pit mine: a three-level stepped pit centered on the plate (rim 44px wide, about 69% of the plate width); a small yellow haul truck loaded with ore on the pit floor; a stockpile cone outside the rim at back-left; a covered, inclined conveyor gallery climbing from the cone across the back to the top of the bin, with a support leg; and a taller timber ore bin at back-right (on trestle legs, with a gable roof and floodlight) as the vertical focal point.
cats.notes: v1 unchanged. v2 was rewritten from scratch (lines 214+, same 72x112 canvas, anchor 36,110). How each rejection point was fixed: (1) Pit too small and flat, shoved into the right third: the pit is now centered on the plate (center 36,96), with openings of half-width 22/16/10 and 3px deeper per level. It is drawn from an isometric hole model: only the back walls show, the back-left walls are dark and the back-right walls lit (light comes from the left), and each level's floor gets darker with depth. (2) Kept 3 levels, each with a light lip and dark wall, at least 2 shades apart: each level has a 1px light lip where its floor drops to the next wall (#d0b68c/#c0a67e/#ac9270). The dark walls are #3e3024/#382a20/#30241c, the lit walls #7a5e40/#6a5038/#5a4430, and the floors #b09470/#9c8260/#806a50. The front rim has a light ground edge outside and a dark line just inside, so the hole reads as closed. At sheet scale it now reads clearly as terraces. (3) Cone and conveyor moved outside the rim at back-left/back: the cone sits in the back-left strip outside the rim. After trying a steep open conveyor (looked like a crane arm) and a short truss (looked like a cannon), I switched to a covered gallery from the cone up to the bin top. It passes above the pit's back corner, and its legs stand on plate outside the rim. (4) Ore vehicle at the center of the pit floor: a small yellow haul truck (cab plus dump bed with ore) sits in the floor's visible area without crossing the front rim. (5) Ore bin raised: it now stands on 7px trestle legs with a 17px body (top about 8px higher than before), plus a gable roof and floodlight, making it the tallest element. Shadows are clipped to the plate so none spill onto the grass. Night lights come only from the floodlight head drawn on the bin top and the truck headlight pixel. Randomness uses only RND(50,2)=A.metroRand516('v574:50:2'). Nothing floats, nothing is cropped by the canvas edge, and there is no stray-pixel noise; I checked a 3x nearest-neighbour crop at iter2–iter6. Detail density stays at or below v0: 1583 opaque pixels vs v0's 2291. No custom draw path: grep for k===50 in index.html lines 23000–25500 found nothing.

cats.notes: 這輪只改 v1，v2 照總監意見保留沒動。三條退件的處理：(1) 彩虹帶：從 2px、4 色、只在左牆，改成 3px 高、6 個高彩度純色（#ff3434 / #ff9014 / #ffd400 / #2fcf3f / #1f8fff / #9a4cff），每色 3px 寬，繞左右兩面牆。右牆只壓暗 18 保持受光邏輯，彩度沒降。(2) 沙坑：原本是 #e2cf9a、3×4 單位，又落在地塊陰影裡，看起來灰灰的。現在改成 #fbe9ae 淺沙色、3×7.5 單位，外圍靠 outlineSprite 給 1px 深木框 (58,42,26)，遠側兩緣有 1px 較深的沙色內陰影，讀得出是凹下去的。沙坑單獨畫一層，在 finishFresh 之後才疊上去，只套 grainBands，這樣不會被建築的地面陰影橢圓和 material 的 AO 壓灰。第一輪沙坑離屋身只有 1.5 單位，兩條外框交錯成棋盤狀雜點，所以把屋身往後退一格、沙坑往前挪，兩者之間留約 3px 草地。第二輪發現小紅桶頂到遠側框線上，已移進沙面內。(3) 溜滑梯：原本是棕色木梯柱加橘色細滑道，約 16×12px。現在是紅色雙梯柱塔（高 18px），每 2px 一條亮紅梯級，外框填進梯級間的空隙後，梯子在 1x 也看得出來；另外有黃色平台、紅色扶手框、3px 厚亮黃滑道（上緣亮黃高光、下緣橘色唇）、落地緩衝段和中段支腳。外框大小約 21×23px，面積大約是原本的 2.5 倍，高度約 1.9 倍。寬度只放大約 1.3 倍，因為 1×1 地塊東角放不下更長的滑道；滑道末端離地塊東角只剩約 4px。溜滑梯的接地陰影直接畫在地塊上，塔腳不浮空。夜圖只有畫出來的窗戶會亮，沙坑和溜滑梯沒有燈。已知取捨：沙坑沒吃地塊陰影，夜景裡比周圍稍微亮一點；溜滑梯塔頂和屋脊一樣高，比例上偏大，這是為了照總監要求放大到 2 倍。
